title: Replace harvested typo-RAM objects 80542c/805434/805438 with one 28-byte object; prove users; install the two Bis completion units; private p-80542c rebuild; paired Renode sims both PASS (run_renode_rc=0)
scope: Stock-check every user of 0x80542c..0x805447, merge three 1-byte harvested objects into one 28-byte typo-RAM struct, retarget users, QEMU-ARC 100-case prove plus killed mutants, install, private p-lowers, NVM slot-fit, private NOR splice, both paired sims.

prior_p_usuf29_dfu_confirmation.note: The p-usuf29 DFU log and shell run were rechecked this turn. The evidence file was updated so sims.forced_mismatch_dfu.result is PASS, sims.forced_mismatch_dfu.run_renode_rc is 0, compare.forced_mismatch_dfu_baseline is PASS, and compare.forced_mismatch_dfu_run_renode_rc is 0.

stock_check.result: Stock uses one 28-byte scratch at 0x80542c that spans the harvested 1-byte objects at 0x805434 and 0x805438. The next typo-RAM table is BIS_TXENT_TAB at 0x805448, so the 28-byte block fits exactly. Previous object is 805408 (1 byte). Next typo-RAM object after the table is 805688.

users.init_native_callback_3286f8.c: memset 0x1c bytes at 0x80542c, already typo-RAM retargeted to &em9305_ram_80542c
users.lctrSlvBigBeginOp.c: comment 0x1c-byte scratch cleared on entry; memset(0x80542cu, 0, 0x1c); writes +0x10, +0x14, +0x18, and a header at +6. Still literals; not installed this pass (prior u-suffix prove RUN FAILED).
users.lctrSlvBisTxCompletionInterleaved.c: TX cursor at 0x80542c: W32(+0) key, B8(+4) idx, W32(+0x10) ts, W32(+0x14) ptr, W32(+0x18) flag; also passes the base pointer to dispatch_child_3173ac
users.lctrSlvBisTxCompletionSequential.c: same cursor fields; B8(+0) compared to big+0x34; dispatch_child_317418
users.lctrSlvBisTxData.c: B8(+0/+1/+3) row/col/col2, W32(+0x10) and W32(+0x14). Still literals; not installed this pass (prior RUN FAILED).
users.lctrSlvBisTxControl.c: W32(0x805444u) is the +0x18 flag/header pointer, last word of the 28-byte block. Still literals; not installed this pass (prior RUN FAILED).
users.lctrSlvBisSetupTxData.c: per-stream counters at 0x805434 and 0x805438 (+index a); W32(805438+0x0c) is the +0x18 flag; BIS_CNT_B-6 is the address 0x805432 (g+6 header). Indexed by stream id from BeginOp loop i < B8(big+0x34) and 328dd4 loop i < U8(link+52). The 28-byte layout only has 4 bytes for each counter bank before ts/ptr/flag; a stock index >=4 would already overlap those words and the 0x805448 table. Counters are modeled as u8[4] fields at +8 and +0xc.

source_fix.em9305_ram_80542c: seven 4-byte anonymous unions (u32 plus u8[4]) covering +0..+0x18, offsetof asserts, _Static_assert(sizeof==28). Removed struct em9305_ram_805434 and struct em9305_ram_805438.
source_fix.ld_change: Kept em9305_ram_80542c = 0x0080542c. Removed em9305_ram_805434 and em9305_ram_805438 assignments because those C objects no longer exist. The 28-byte object stays at the same absolute base; no new ld address was required.
